mentions.name: Open-Write
mentions.description: This system uses LLMs to efficiently generate long-form narrative content. It began as a stress test to see where LLMs break down on long-form generation, originally aimed at producing narrative content for unscripted NPCs, and grew into a full system for producing long-form content.
mentions.source_excerpt: I was thinking about how to get LLMs to efficiently generate narrative content for unscripted NPCs and then I ended up building Open-Write. What started as a test to see where the system would break down on long-form content generation, just became a system for producing long-form content generation.
